sections.content: Time to combine everything: variables, conditions, loops, functions, data structures, and error handling into one real program.
Pick a small useful tool — a number guessing game, a to-do list manager, a quiz scorer, or a unit converter. Start with the simplest version that works, then add features one at a time.
Key points: plan the features first, build the core loop early, test each piece, and finish something you can actually show people.
Summary: Capstone Project — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
